proofs.statement: The compiler-decoded metadata segment is the sole normalized difference; all executable and compiler-declared immutable bytes are exactly the observed deployment after the captured immutable patches. This is not arbitrary byte masking or implementation approval by class name.

Chief escrowed-token approval authorizes DSPause.plot; public plan identity binds usr/tag/full fax/eta before a source-enforced 172800-second clock. Proxy.exec is only callable by Pause and checks unchanged ownership. Governor-only owner/delay/authority changes cannot bypass the previously applicable public clock; this closed cycle is not an independent authority alternative.

DaiJoin and UsdsJoin consume existing caller Vat credit on exit; native denomination conversion burns exactly the same wad it mints. The two ERC20 totalSupply values are summed once; savings shares, wrappers and join backing reserves are not added as additional native supply or keeper budgets. Vat/dai/token unit conversions use RAY exactly.

Dog.bark removes a fresh positive normalized-debt slice and calls one kick; further partial barks require distinct remaining debt. Vat Art conserves the sum of integer urn.art, bounding both positive debt positions and paid fragments by Art_raw, not an observed urn count. Open new debt uses current frob dust and post-penalty-tab reward conversion. Closed ilks use finite stock plus licensed rate-growth/backlog bounds; no absolute daily initial-turnover cap is claimed.

Every Clipper repeat uses its own strict tail/cusp calculator boundary and fresh-feed funding gate. Any half-open day includes the conservative ceil(86400/delta)+one-boundary-stock multiplier.
